dedupe_keys.name: trust iov simulated vehicle interaction and attack benchmark

description: The Zenodo Trust-IoV release is a simulated benchmark of communication and trust interactions among 96 vehicles, including normal participants and malicious agents. Its article describes 1,048,576 interactions and four trust measures: interaction experience, frequency, recency and received-message quality. Attack classes include on-off, self-promotion and opportunistic behaviour. Zenodo lists one ZIP archive under CC BY 4.0. These are generated labels for testing trust management in connected-vehicle simulations, not observed attack rates on a deployed road network. The simulator assumptions, chosen vehicle mix and synthetic attack rules are limitations when estimating real transport cyber risk. A reviewer-assessed use is checking whether an agent-based connected-vehicle model detects trust manipulation before it affects route or safety decisions. model-sumo is a related traffic simulator; no vehicle trajectories or direct interface to this benchmark were verified. The public repository page and named archive were checked without downloading the data or running an attack model. Coverage is the specified 96-vehicle simulated network, with no observed road fleet.
